additional_terms: GenImage Dataset Terms prevail where they conflict with CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
compliance_controls: Preserve attribution to GenImage authors and cite the GenImage paper in research outputs using the dataset.
Preserve the official dataset source, license identity, additional Dataset Terms, acquisition provenance, and native labels/splits.
Do not sell the dataset, dataset copies, or derivative dataset material; do not use it for commercial gain.
Do not commit or redistribute raw GenImage image/archive bytes through the AEGIS Git repository.
If licensed/adapted dataset material is shared, perform a release-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and GenImage Dataset Terms compliance review before sharing.
Do not represent GenImage material as being relicensed merely because AEGIS code or documentation uses another license.
Preserve upstream-source provenance: the official repository states nature images are collected from ImageNet.
Do not assume the GenImage license resolves every upstream right in source images; avoid unnecessary raw-image republication.
Re-check the then-current official Dataset Terms before any public dataset-derived release, operational deployment, commercial use, or transfer to a third party.
